summary: Private raft overturned in the Poudre River just east of Mishawaka ~3 p.m.; one adult male rafter unaccounted for. The International Emergency Response Coordination Center relayed an SOS activation from the party's supported device. The man was pulled from the river; a citizen witness, a Colorado Parks and Wildlife officer and three deputies performed CPR; he was driven by CPW vehicle to Hewlett Gulch, transferred to a medical helicopter and flown to a local hospital where he was pronounced deceased.
responding_agency: Larimer County Sheriff's Office, Colorado Parks and Wildlife, medical helicopter
